description: List job interviews that are being actively tracked by JobGPT (detected from email confirmations). Use upcoming=true to get scheduled/rescheduled interviews. Can also filter by application ID or status.

jobApplicationId.description: Filter interviews for a specific job application

limit.description: Number of results per page (default: 20, max: 50)

upcoming.description: If true, returns only upcoming interviews (SCHEDULED or RESCHEDULED)

name: list_interviews
